result.summary: The firmware mechanics in FINDINGS hold up (A1 dispatch, 0x40 vs 0x800, sub_0f68c/sub_0f740 semantics, A1 05 as the correct stop, container fields, DFU region untouched, no null-pointer or timer hazard from a never-started VC30F: sub_10dbe null-checks at 0x10dcc/0x10dd4/0x10dfa, sub_0eff8 creates no timers, measurement timers are bounded). The critical gaps are elsewhere. (1) The verifiers checked a one-halfword patch (0xf710 e5e7, sha 3c57b73e) that is not what the repo builds: whip/fwoptical.py, edited after every verifier artifact and again during this session, produces a five-site image (sha f862e5bb) -- bx lr at sub_0f68c, a 36-byte idle guard in its reclaimed body, a bl into it from the STK state machine at 0xcad2, A1 case 4 rewritten to store mode 4 and call the STK start request sub_0cb06, and VC30F RUN mapped to 0x00 at 0x1231a. I decoded all five sites (targets, LR, r4/r7 liveness, literals 0x209cac/0x209e09, no other references into the reclaimed body, container recomputed, 59 tests pass) and they are mechanically sound, but hardware-unvalidated and outside the review record. (2) The e5e7 image would stream a frozen accelerometer when still: the STK START path arms its own idle request (0xca7c) and sub_0cbda then repeats a cached sample; LED_FIX evidence 3-5 shows exactly that on stock, which is why the design moved. (3) The host's 'stop heart rate' 69 01 04 is a START (0x517e enable bit 0x1) that blocks A1 05 from stopping the chip on stock; the disable is 69 06 04. (4) 16 02 02 3c clears only bit0 of the five schedule bits (cmds 0x16/0x2c/0x36/0x38/0x3a); on the e5e7 image every idle-time optical start (schedule, 0x69, indicator patterns, charger) is live mid-stream. (5) After a disconnect the mode byte stays 4, so the producer timer and the DLPS veto persist until the host sends A1 05/02 on reconnect. Fix A (A1 05 + A1 02) can proceed now with the 69 01 04 removal; the five-site firmware may proceed only to a bench test after the listed pinning, re-review and hardware checks.
